_comment: Topic-specific categories first, then generic ones. The keyword classifier uses the first matches.

categories.name: Loan rejected or hard to qualify
categories.description: Applications denied, unclear eligibility, slow approvals, too much paperwork.

categories.name: High interest, EMIs & charges
categories.description: High interest or APR, EMI burden, processing and prepayment fees, rate hikes.

categories.name: Recovery harassment & debt collection
categories.description: Recovery agents, harassing calls, threats, debt collectors contacting family.

categories.name: Credit score problems
categories.description: Low or wrong credit scores, report errors, hard to improve.

categories.name: Loan app scams
categories.description: Fake instant-loan apps, illegal lenders, data misuse.

categories.name: Price, fees & hidden charges
categories.description: Too expensive, price rises, surge pricing, hidden fees, not worth the money.

categories.name: Quality & reliability
categories.description: Product or service breaks, fails, is defective, inconsistent or does not work as promised.

categories.name: Availability & access
categories.description: Not available nearby, out of stock, no coverage, long distances, closed or full.
keywords: near me|where (to|can i)|\b(not available|unavailable|out of stock|no (service|coverage|stations?|options?)|closed|full|sold out)\b

categories.name: Delays & waiting
categories.description: Late delivery, long queues or wait times, slow service, missed appointments.

categories.name: Customer support
categories.description: Hard to reach support, complaints ignored, unhelpful agents, no accountability.

categories.name: Refunds, billing & payments
categories.description: Refund refused or slow, double charges, payment failures, billing errors, cancellation trouble.

categories.name: App, website & digital
categories.description: App or website bugs, login problems, confusing UX, booking or tracking not working.

categories.name: Trust, scams & safety
categories.description: Fraud, scams, misleading claims, data or personal safety concerns.

categories.name: How-to questions & confusing rules
categories.description: Unclear rules, eligibility, instructions or terms; people unsure how things work.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: First-time / new user
personas.description: Trying the product or service for the first time; unfamiliar with how it works.

personas.name: Regular user
personas.description: Uses it often and compares with past experience.

personas.name: Budget-conscious customer
personas.description: Price-sensitive; talks mainly about cost and value.

personas.name: Small business / professional user
personas.description: Uses it for work or a business.
